data.other_hard: Master's or PhD degree obtained within the last ten years of applying; older degrees considered if further supporting information is provided
data.evidence_sentence: All Europeans are eligible to apply (including UK, Israel, Switzerland, Turkey, Balkan and Baltic countries).
data.notes: Page states 'no limitations or restrictions' but also lists European-only eligibility. The listed deadline (15 September 2026) is in the past; the next deadline is not stated. Level 'other' is used because this is a research fellowship for holders of a Master's or PhD, not degree study. No funding amount or type is stated. Applications from members of commercial, industrial, governmental or professional organisations are also accepted. Research period can end in 2028.
